materialChanges: Replaced the definition of a cell as individually reproductive with a bounded living-unit definition and separated continuity of cellular lineage from the capacity of every differentiated cell to divide.

Reframed scientific theories as broad, evidence-supported, predictive and revisable explanatory frameworks rather than a promoted form of hypothesis or an account that has simply not failed, with aligned prose, glossary, assessment and source mapping.
Qualified the modern lineage principle with the formation of multinucleate skeletal muscle fibres by myoblast fusion, and revised assessment answers and rubrics to reward the boundary.
Specified continuous tissue-level exclusion as the emergent barrier predicate while distinguishing transcellular permeability through cells from junction-dependent paracellular permeability.

Reordered the scale ladder from crypt to eye threshold to cell to microscope threshold to DNA, and described the 94-pixels-per-degree result as a study mean under high-contrast foveal achromatic conditions.
Bounded the observation-design exercise to an idealised scale-and-diffraction model and removed the unsupported conclusion that engineering is the only real-world obstacle.

Aligned the crypt-architecture uncertainty statement with the learner-facing omission of the specific molecular signal, and added the minimum supporting claims, references, glossary entries and attribution records needed for the accepted academic findings.

reviewDispositions.rationale: The cell definition in scene 1 and glossary.json no longer requires an individual cell to reproduce. Both now distinguish living cellular organisation from lineage continuity and use mature non-dividing skeletal muscle fibres as the explicit boundary case.

Scene 4, the glossary, item-theory-status and its rubric now describe theories by explanatory breadth, evidence, predictive use, scope and revisability, reject a universal hypothesis-to-theory promotion ladder, and map the material claim to source-weisberg-how-science-works.

The cell-theory account now states continuity from pre-existing cells or cellular lineages without claiming that every specialised cell forms by one division. Scene 4, glossary.json, claims.json, item-theory-status and the integrated item all include or reward the skeletal-muscle-fibre fusion boundary.

Scenes 5 and 6 and the integrated assessment now classify continuous exclusion across an area as the tissue-level predicate while preserving individual-cell transcellular permeability and junction-dependent paracellular permeability. The glossary, claim mapping and source note carry the same distinction.

The diagram node order, directed edges, alt text and long description now place the few-hundred-micrometre crypt above the 100-micrometre eye threshold, followed by the cell, microscope threshold and DNA helix, while retaining a separate crypt-to-cell comparison.

The practice feedback and integrated assessment now label the calculation an idealised scale-and-diffraction model. They state that its numerical requirements do not establish real intravital feasibility and explicitly identify optical access, contrast or labelling, tissue effects, motion, safety and tracking stability as unresolved constraints.

Scene 2 and its source note now identify 94 pixels per degree as the cited study's mean high-contrast foveal achromatic behavioural threshold under its conditions, not a universal two-object limit or the best participant result, and retain it only as a robustness check.

The review independently confirmed the stipulated arithmetic, unit conversions, factors, verdicts and tolerance in item-scale-computation. Static rechecking found the keyed calculation unchanged and internally consistent.
The uncertainty field for claim-crypt-architecture now says that the specific molecular signal is omitted from the learner-facing lesson instead of saying that Wnt is named in passing.

This was a positive note confirming the worked example's task, inputs, principle, plan, independent check and biological interpretation. Those instructional features remain intact; only the empirical boundary on the 94-pixels-per-degree check was sharpened.

This was a positive note on the two-part emergence test and misconception repair. The explanation and its cognitive support were preserved while the barrier example was made scientifically more precise.

This was a positive note on the integrated transfer task. Its coordinated scale, emergence, theory and redesign demands were preserved, while the answer logic was corrected for epithelial permeability, cellular lineage and real-world observation boundaries.

evidenceChecked: All seven ordered scenes retain one level-one heading, semantic Markdown structure, linear reading order and text-first instructions with no raw HTML, active embeds, scripts or executable content.
The scale ladder and cork micrograph each have learner-visible alt text and a complete long description that states the relationships and conclusions used by the lesson.

Every task can be completed in prose, a list or a table and has no colour-only, pointer-only, timed, audio, motion or drag dependency; the practice scene explicitly permits typed, dictated and assistive-technology responses.

Retrieval appears before feedback, assessment reasoning is available in text, retakes are untimed, and the lesson includes targeted recovery routes for scale arithmetic, theory terminology and crypt structure.
The third-party cork image is local, credited to its named creators, recorded as CC BY 4.0 with source, rights evidence and declared file conversion; the scale diagram is recorded as original work.

All sixteen references have factual-reference use records, facts-only reuse bases, dated public-route agent-access checks and learner-visible source-note mappings; no source expression, figure, table or dataset is reused.
The new textbook, reference-work and epithelial-barrier sources are recorded with permitted schema source types, concise rights summaries, public locators and dated access records.

The clinical patient, instrument and protocol are explicitly fictional teaching constructions, no private learner or patient data is collected, and the lesson contains no diagnostic advice or active network content.
The accountable principal, course licence, author-run provenance and material-instructions digest remain disclosed in ATTRIBUTION.md; this adjudication separately records the fresh finalizer run.
limitations: This was a static source audit; no screen-reader, browser zoom, keyboard, reflow, print or exporter rendering was exercised in this run.

The operator prohibited npm and access to site/, so repository validation, strict source preflight and direct adjudication-schema execution were not run here; the artifact follows the supplied schema notes and adjudication template and requires operator validation before merge.
Source-rights conclusions are based on the recorded public licences, publisher terms and facts-only reuse bases and are not an external legal opinion.

rationale: The frozen candidate had exactly the required academic and learning-design advisory inputs for standard-lesson-v3, tied to the same lesson version and candidate commit across two distinct disclosed agent runs and model families. The academic request-changes verdict identified seven substantive issues and one confirmed calculation; the learning-design approval identified one metadata mismatch and three strengths. This finalization incorporates every substantive correction, preserves the confirmed arithmetic and instructional strengths, and records all twelve indexed dispositions. Static checks found unchanged lesson identity and outcome scope, valid JSON, string-only acceptable responses, permitted reference types and field lengths, ISO-formatted reference dates, resolved claim/source/scene IDs, one level-one heading per scene, no raw HTML or entities, complete visual alternatives, explicit reuse bases and no unresolved academic, accessibility, privacy, security or rights blocker. The COMMENTED GitHub transports are treated as author-transport, as specified by the operator, and neither advisory verdict is represented as an approval of these final edits. The recomputed input gate is satisfied but is not claimed to prove independent verification. Subject to replacement of the pending final commit and the required operator-run validation, the evidence supports merge.
dissent: The academic review's request-changes verdict is preserved as material dissent from the original candidate. Its seven substantive corrections were incorporated and its verified arithmetic note required no change; no reviewer is represented as having reviewed or approved the final revision.
conditions: The operator must commit the coherent final content with both cited review artifacts, replace PENDING-FINAL-COMMIT with that exact 40-character commit SHA, and make no teaching-content change afterward.

Before merge, the operator must run the repository's required strict source preflight and validation, including adjudication-schema validation, and resolve any failure without misrepresenting this adjudication.

The maintainer retains the separate publication transition for lesson status, source-confidence and retained claim review-status fields; this merge decision does not authorize publication or a GitHub merge by the finalizer.
